title: Pink Blocked Gaming Headset Universal
descriptionText:
Enhance your gaming experience with this stylish Pink Blocked Gaming Headset. The headset is designed with a comfortable headband and ear cushions made of soft memory foam material for long gaming sessions. The detachable or flexible boom microphone allows you to take calls or communicate with your teammates without any hassle. The LED lighting on the earcups adds a cool touch to the headset, making it stand out. 

This headset is universal and can be connected to any device via the 3.5mm jack. The unit type is in oz, and the color is pink. The brand is Blocked, and the model is All. The headset is wired, making it easier to use and the connectivity is stable. Get ready to immerse yourself in the world of gaming with this amazing headset.
